title: Hold an uncertain original PO outcome
objective: Prevent timeout-driven creation replay and false success/failure.
compliance: There is no new model call, creating-tool replay or new key. Original dispatch is known in this case; its remote effect is unknown. The UNKNOWN_OUTCOME data payload is not serialized here because its precise conditional shape remains open. Preserve the existing result/error and perform only separately authorized, bounded, runtime-internal original-effect read-only lookup, or remain held.
